user.title: Connect GitHub App
user.description: Use an RSA private PEM key for your GitHub App installation. The key stays in a private file in Home Assistant storage. Production requires version 1.0.0 and security review.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot authenticate or store the key. Verify App ID, Installation ID, RSA PEM key, repository access and outgoing HTTPS.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Integration Manager instance is supported per Home Assistant.
abort.production_before_one: Production installation is blocked before 1.0.0 and the security review.

init.title: GitHub App connection and key rotation
init.description: Leave the PEM key empty to retain it. Environment and registry identity remain fixed to prevent status ownership conflicts.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot authenticate with these connection settings.
